item.title: 我们跟库克聊了聊 iPhone Duo
item.description:
On October 11, Tim Cook stated during a discussion with APPSO in Guangzhou about iPhone Duo's app adaptation that developers should fully utilize the larger, more immersive screen, explore different usage methods, and consider various user holding angles. 10 月 11 日，蒂姆·库克在广州与 APPSO 交流 iPhone Duo 的应用适配时表示，开发者应充分利用更大、更具沉浸感的屏幕，探索不同使用方式，并考虑用户不同的握持角度。

APPSO observed on-site that the Guangzhou food map created by Xmind for iPhone Duo changes with the device's opening and closing form. The Xmind team introduced that they completed the adaptation in half a month and designed a "half-screen display" outline mode for the hinge, allowing mind maps and outlines to collaborate in split-screen; Cook also affirmed this adaptation. APPSO 在现场看到，Xmind 为 iPhone Duo 制作的广州美食地图会随设备开合形态变化。Xmind 团队介绍，他们用半个月完成了适配，并针对铰链设计了「半屏展示」大纲模式，让思维导图与大纲分屏协同；库克也对这一适配给予肯定。

APPSO also observed that during the use of some applications, the system adds spacing on both sides of the hinge to ensure that the interactive area avoids creases. The layout changes brought about by the folding form became the focus of this on-site discussion. APPSO 还观察到，部分应用在使用过程中，系统会在铰链两侧增加间距，确保交互区域避开折痕。折叠形态带来的布局变化，成为这次现场交流的重点。

On the same day, Guangdong Governor Meng Fanli met with Cook and his delegation in Guangzhou. Cook stated that Guangdong is crucial for Apple's development in China and expressed willingness to further expand its business layout in Guangdong, discussing cooperation in supply chain, innovation ecosystem, intelligent manufacturing, green manufacturing, and sales channels. 同日，广东省省长孟凡利在广州会见库克一行。库克表示，广东对苹果在华发展至关重要，愿进一步扩大在粤业务布局，围绕供应链、创新生态、智能制造和绿色制造、销售渠道等方面探讨合作。

🔗 Related reading: Just now, I chatted with Cook about iPhone Duo 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，我跟库克聊了聊 iPhone Duo

item.title: 曝苹果与 ADT 合作，为家居中枢提供安装服务
item.guid: 曝苹果与-ADT-合作，为家居中枢提供安装服务
item.description:
According to MacRumors, Apple may partner with US home security company ADT to provide in-home installation services for upcoming smart home hubs and related accessories. Apple has invited media to a "Welcome home" event in New York on October 13, and reports speculate that the partnership may be announced on that day. 据 MacRumors 报道，苹果可能与美国家庭安防公司 ADT 建立合作，为即将推出的智能家居中枢及相关配件提供上门安装服务。苹果已邀请媒体于 10 月 13 日参加纽约的「Welcome home」活动，报道推测，合作可能在当天公布。

The report cited low-voltage technicians recruited by ADT in recent months. Some new employees said that after joining, they mainly followed other technicians to learn and had not yet learned their full responsibilities; some employees and managers signed relevant confidentiality agreements. This group of employees received iPhone work phones, while other technicians used Android devices. 报道援引 ADT 近几个月招聘的低压技术员说法。部分新员工称，入职后主要跟随其他技术员学习，尚未获知完整职责；一些员工及经理签署了相关保密协议。这批员工获得的是 iPhone 工作机，而其他技术员使用 Android 设备。

Other new employees were told that the position involved home automation and on-site installation. Work details originally scheduled for September were also postponed to October. Based on this, the report speculates that ADT technicians may be responsible for installing wall-mounted home hubs, or accessories developed by Apple in cooperation with brands such as LG. 另有新员工被告知，岗位涉及家庭自动化及上门安装。原定 9 月说明的工作细节也被延至 10 月。报道据此推测，ADT 技术员可能负责安装壁挂式家居中枢，或苹果与 LG 等品牌合作开发的配件。

The above cooperation is still a rumor, and it has not yet been confirmed whether it covers home security monitoring. MacRumors also cited sources as saying that ADT's exclusive agreement with Google recently expired and will not be renewed; Google is turning to cooperate with AT&T. 上述合作仍属传闻，是否涵盖家庭安防监控也尚无确认。MacRumors 同时援引知情人士称，ADT 与 Google 的独家协议近期已经到期，且不会续约；Google 正转向与 AT&T 合作。

item.title: 蔚来广东换电站达到 500 座，六城同步新增第五代站
item.guid: 蔚来广东换电站达到-500-座，六城同步新增第五代站
item.description:
On October 11, Nio announced that six fifth-generation battery swap stations were simultaneously launched in six cities: Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Huizhou, Dongguan, Foshan, and Zhuhai, bringing the total number of battery swap stations in Guangdong to 500. 10 月 11 日，蔚来宣布，广州、深圳、惠州、东莞、佛山和珠海六座城市同步上线六座第五代换电站，广东换电站数量达到 500 座。

It is reported that Nio battery swap stations in Guangdong have cumulatively provided over 17 million battery swap services. The fifth-generation stations were simultaneously launched in six cities this time, further expanding the province's battery swap network. 据悉，广东蔚来换电站累计提供的换电服务已超过 1700 万次。第五代站此次在六城同时落地，继续扩展省内换电网络。

As of October 11, Nio's national charging and battery swap stations totaled 9,584, including 4,176 battery swap stations; the highway network has deployed 1,073 battery swap stations, covering "9 vertical, 11 horizontal, and 16 major urban clusters," connecting over 550 cities. 截至 10 月 11 日，蔚来全国充换电站合计 9584 座，其中换电站 4176 座；高速公路网络已部署 1073 座换电站，覆盖「9 纵 11 横 16 大城市群」，连通超过 550 座城市。

item.title: SpaceXAI 改为 SpaceXSI，官方账号换上「超级智能」名称
item.guid: SpaceXAI-改为-SpaceXSI，官方账号换上「超级智能」名称
item.description:
SpaceXAI's official social media account has changed its display name to "SpaceX Super Intelligence" and its username to @SpaceXSI. A screenshot posted by Musk on October 10 local time showed this adjustment; SI in the new name is an abbreviation for Super Intelligence, and the account still lists the x.ai website. SpaceXAI 的官方社交账号已将显示名称改为「SpaceX Super Intelligence」，用户名变为 @SpaceXSI。马斯克当地时间 10 月 10 日发布的截图展示了这一调整；新名称中的 SI 是 Super Intelligence（超级智能）的缩写，账号仍列出 x.ai 网站。

This change follows Musk's previous public statements. In an X post on October 4, he wrote: "SpaceX is a super intelligence company." According to TechSpot's report on the interaction at the time, when a user asked if SpaceXAI would be changed to SpaceXSI, Musk replied: "Yes, we will make this change." 这次改动延续了马斯克此前的公开表态。他在 10 月 4 日的 X 帖文中写道：「SpaceX 是一家超级智能公司。」据 TechSpot 对当时互动的报道，当用户问到 SpaceXAI 是否会改成 SpaceXSI 时，马斯克回答：「是的，我们会做出这一改变。」

The statement in early October was a name change preview, and this screenshot and official account show that the name adjustment has been implemented. The publicly available information involves changes to social media account names and usernames. 10 月初的表态是改名预告，此次截图和官方账号则显示名称调整已经落地。已公开的信息涉及社交账号名称与用户名变更。

item.title: 继 QClaw 之后，腾讯元器宣布 11 月 9 日停服
item.guid: 继-QClaw-之后，腾讯元器宣布-11-月-9-日停服
item.description:
Following QClaw's announcement of its discontinuation by the end of the year, Tencent's other intelligent agent platform, Yuanqi, also announced its service termination schedule. The Yuanqi team stated in an official notice on October 8 that due to business adjustments, the platform will cease services on November 9, and existing intelligent agents will also become unavailable at that time. 继 QClaw 宣布将于年底停运后，腾讯另一款智能体平台元器也公布了停服安排。元器团队在 10 月 8 日的官方通知中称，因业务调整，平台将于 11 月 9 日停止服务，届时存量智能体也将不可用。

The service termination will proceed in two steps: on October 29, the creation of new intelligent agents and API key distribution will cease; on November 9, application access, data read/write, APIs, and the console will be shut down. Intelligent agents previously published to official accounts, service accounts, WeChat customer service, and other channels will also no longer be able to respond. 停服分两步进行：10 月 29 日停止创建新智能体及 API key 分发；11 月 9 日关闭应用访问、数据读写、API 和控制台。此前发布到公众号、服务号、微信客服等渠道的智能体，也将无法继续响应。

Users can export intelligent agent configurations, workflows, and conversation records. After the service termination, the data export console will retain a transition period until January 9, 2027; after this, user data will be deleted, except for logs and other data required to be retained by law. The official recommendation is to migrate to Tencent Cloud Intelligent Agent Development Platform ADP, or use official account intelligent replies, and provides migration benefits and original resource refund arrangements. 用户可导出智能体配置、工作流和对话记录。停服后，数据导出控制台仍保留过渡期，至 2027 年 1 月 9 日；此后用户数据将被删除，依法需要留存的日志等除外。官方建议迁往腾讯云智能体开发平台 ADP，或使用公众号智能回复，并提供迁移权益及原资源退费安排。

QClaw announced on September 24 that it would cease operations at midnight on December 24. Tencent sources previously told Yicai that the company is further integrating resources and providing QClaw users with tools to migrate to WorkBuddy. QClaw 则于 9 月 24 日宣布，将在 12 月 24 日零时停止运营。腾讯相关人士此前向第一财经表示，公司正进一步整合资源，并为 QClaw 用户提供迁往 WorkBuddy 的工具。

item.title: 苹果 COO 探访郑州工厂，披露 iPhone Duo 屏幕与芯片制造工艺
item.guid: 苹果-COO-探访郑州工厂，披露-iPhone-Duo-屏幕与芯片制造工艺
item.description:
On October 11, Apple COO Sabih Khan visited Foxconn's Zhengzhou Science Park and Yuto Tech's Xuchang factory. Media materials provided by Apple disclosed parts of the manufacturing process for iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro series, from screens and cameras to chip packaging and packaging boxes. 10 月 11 日，苹果首席运营官 Sabih Khan 参观富士康郑州科技园及裕同科技许昌工厂。苹果提供的媒体材料披露了 iPhone Duo、iPhone 18 Pro 系列从屏幕、摄像头到芯片封装、包装盒的部分制造流程。

At Foxconn, Apple and its suppliers created custom equipment for the iPhone Duo hinge area: confocal lasers scan the microscopic topography of the screen substrate layer by layer, machine learning algorithms instantly generate filling solutions, and then micro-scale 3D printing forms up to 25 layers of photosensitive polymer to build a flat support base. 在富士康，苹果与供应商为 iPhone Duo 铰链区域打造了定制设备：共聚焦激光逐层扫描屏幕基底的微观形貌，机器学习算法即时生成填充方案，再以微米级 3D 打印成型多达 25 层光敏聚合物，构建平整的支撑基底。

The iPhone 18 Pro series' mechanical variable aperture camera reads upstream optical calibration data and completes precise assembly through dual active alignment stations. The chip process directly sputters an electromagnetic shielding layer onto the surface of the SoC package, replacing traditional metal shielding covers; Apple states that this reduces module thickness by 20% and improves heat dissipation efficiency. iPhone 18 Pro 系列的机械可变光圈摄像头，通过双主动对准工站读取上游光学标定数据并完成精密装配。芯片工艺则将电磁屏蔽层直接溅镀在 SoC 封装表面，取代传统金属屏蔽罩；苹果称，这使模组厚度缩减 20%，并提升散热效能。

Yuto's Xuchang factory showcased the inline printing, automatic assembly, and quality inspection of iPhone 18 Pro series packaging boxes. Water-based coatings replace plastic film, reducing plastic by over 3,000 tons annually according to the materials released; jointly developed intelligent optical inspection equipment can capture 64 images in 1.9 seconds to inspect the appearance of the packaging boxes. 裕同许昌工厂展示了 iPhone 18 Pro 系列包装盒的联线印刷、自动组装和质检。水性涂层取代塑料覆膜，按材料公布的口径，每年减塑超过 3000 吨；联合研发的智能光学检测设备可在 1.9 秒内采集 64 张图像，检查包装盒外观。

Apple also introduced newly launched manufacturing AI application courses, which have been opened to over 30 factories in China, including online videos and offline practical training. An industrial engineer in the materials created an SOP comparison tool during the course, which can mark changes and generate summaries after uploading new and old operating procedures. 苹果还介绍了新推出的制造业 AI 应用课程，已向中国 30 多家工厂开放，包含线上视频和线下实操。材料中的一名工业工程师在课程中做出 SOP 比对工具，上传新旧两份作业程序后即可标出修改并生成总结。

item.title: 中汽协倡议摒弃「重形式、轻安全」的非理性创新
item.guid: 中汽协倡议摒弃「重形式、轻安全」的非理性创新
item.description:
On October 11, the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers issued an initiative, proposing that automobile companies should abandon irrational innovation that "emphasizes form over safety," prioritize safety assessments throughout the entire product innovation process, and improve the R&D testing and verification system. 中国汽车工业协会 10 月 11 日发布倡议，提出汽车企业应摒弃「重形式、轻安全」的非理性创新，将安全评估前置到产品创新全过程，并完善研发测试验证体系。

The CAAM pointed out that some designs that unilaterally pursue innovation gimmicks, ignore safety bottom lines, and insufficient R&D testing can bring hidden dangers to product safety and industrial development. Its initiatives include standardizing innovative designs, strengthening full-scenario verification such as comprehensive vehicle reliability and adaptability to complex environments, and ensuring product safety through sufficient testing. 中汽协指出，部分片面追求创新噱头、忽视安全底线的设计，以及研发测试不充分等问题，会给产品安全和产业发展带来隐患。其倡议包括规范创新设计、加强车辆综合可靠性和复杂环境适应性等全场景验证，以及用充分测试保障产品安全。

This initiative responds to the draft notice on the management of innovative design and R&D test verification for automotive products, jointly drafted and released by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, and the State Administration for Market Regulation on October 10. The document focuses on the management of unreasonable innovative design and test verification and is currently still in the public comment phase. 这项倡议回应了工业和信息化部会同公安部、生态环境部、市场监管总局于 10 月 10 日起草发布的汽车产品创新设计和研发测试验证管理通知征求意见稿。文件聚焦不合理创新设计与测试验证管理，目前仍处于征求意见阶段。

item.title: 💡 纳德拉：给 AI 配上「紧急刹车」，企业不能外包控制责任
item.guid: 💡-纳德拉：给-AI-配上「紧急刹车」，企业不能外包控制责任
item.description:
On October 10, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella published a lengthy article on X, calling for companies to establish an 'emergency brake' for powerful AI systems: authorized individuals should always be able to pause or shut down a model while it is performing tasks. Companies cannot solely rely on the security assurances of model providers; they must assume from the outset that models may be compromised and be prepared for isolation and control. 10 月 10 日，微软 CEO 萨提亚·纳德拉在 X 发表长文，呼吁企业为强大的 AI 系统建立「紧急刹车」：获得授权的人应始终能在模型执行任务期间暂停或关闭它。企业不能仅依赖模型提供商的安全保证，必须从一开始就假定模型可能遭到入侵，并做好隔离与控制。

Nadella pointed out that while the behavior of traditional software can be traced back to specific code paths, current model behavior is difficult to map to a particular piece of training data or a set of weight configurations. Yet, companies have allowed these systems to access sensitive data and perform critical tasks on their behalf, thus requiring a re-evaluation of trust architectures. He emphasized that treating models as internal risks does not mean deeming them malicious, but rather acknowledging that any powerful entity with access to critical systems can make mistakes or be compromised. 纳德拉指出，传统软件的行为可以追溯到具体代码路径，但当下的模型行为很难对应到某条训练数据或某组权重配置。企业却已让这些系统接触敏感数据、代为执行关键任务，因此必须重新审视信任架构。他强调，把模型当作内部风险，并非认定它们恶意，而是任何能接触重要系统的强大主体都可能犯错或被攻破。

He proposed that models, the execution frameworks that orchestrate their work, and the scope of permissible actions should be separated from each other, and permissions and protective mechanisms must be placed outside the model. Even using another model for adversarial testing might only involve one opaque model supervising another opaque model, which still cannot independently prove system reliability. 他提出，模型、编排其工作的执行框架和允许采取行动的范围应彼此分离，权限与防护机制必须置于模型之外。即便用另一个模型做对抗测试，也可能只是让一个不透明模型监督另一个不透明模型，仍不能独立证明系统可靠。

Specific measures include: 具体措施包括：

    Do not allow a single model to be the sole dependency for important outcomes, nor let it validate its own work independently.

    Leave tamper-proof, human-readable records for every important action, and continuously test for failures, attacks, and edge cases.

    Companies should independently determine access permissions and scope of action, retaining mechanisms for independent auditing, manual mid-task shutdowns, and timely disclosure of security incidents.

item.title: 阿维塔 T09 概念版首秀，定位旗舰六座 SUV
item.guid: 阿维塔-T09-概念版首秀，定位旗舰六座-SUV
item.description:
On October 11, the Avatr T09 concept version made its global debut. This flagship SUV was jointly designed by Avatr and Huawei Qiankun, with a styling that continues the design direction of the VISION XPECTRA concept car and is equipped with four LiDAR sensors. 10 月 11 日，阿维塔 T09 概念版迎来全球首秀。这款旗舰 SUV 由阿维塔与华为乾崑联合设计，造型延续 VISION XPECTRA 概念车的设计方向，配备四颗激光雷达。

The new car features crystal diamond array headlights, a sculpted grille, and through-type taillights. The body has a two-tone division of 'crimson red' and 'cotton white,' and the D-pillar is equipped with an illuminated emblem. The interior interactive screen extends to both sides, forming an integrated layout with the car doors. 新车采用晶钻阵列大灯、雕塑式格栅与贯穿式尾灯，车身以「绛红」和「棉白」形成双色分界，D 柱还设置了发光徽标。车内互动屏幕向两侧延伸，与车门形成一体化布局。

Previous declaration data showed that the T09 is a six-seater model, with a length of 5285mm, a width of 2025mm, and a wheelbase of 3150mm, offering two different power systems. One uses a 1.5-liter engine with front and rear dual motors, while the other uses a 2.0-liter engine with a three-motor layout. The version unveiled this time is still a concept, and the declared parameters and debut design correspond to information from different stages. 此前申报资料显示，T09 为六座车型，车长 5285mm、宽 2025mm，轴距 3150mm，提供两种不同的动力系统。其中一款采用 1.5 升发动机与前后双电机，另一款采用 2.0 升发动机与三电机布局。此次亮相的仍是概念版，申报参数与首秀设计分别对应不同阶段的信息。

item.title: 苹果据报为 iPhone Duo 增设门店体验区，旗舰店备逾 150 台样机
item.guid: 苹果据报为-iPhone-Duo-增设门店体验区，旗舰店备逾-150-台样机
item.description:
According to MacRumors, citing Mark Gurman, Apple is preparing new displays and a large number of demo units for the iPhone Duo, which goes on sale on October 23. The flagship store on Fifth Avenue in New York will allocate a dedicated area, and most stores will add a display table and use new devices to showcase the phone's folding and unfolding process. 据 MacRumors 援引 Mark Gurman 报道，苹果正为 10 月 23 日开售的 iPhone Duo 准备新陈列与大量体验机。纽约第五大道旗舰店将划出专门区域，多数门店会增加一张展示桌，并使用新装置展示手机的折叠与展开过程。

The allocation quantities vary significantly by store: Fifth Avenue is expected to receive over 150 demo units, the Apple Park Visitor Center nearly 100 units, and average stores about 20 units. Three stores—Chicago's Michigan Avenue, Los Angeles's The Grove, and Manhattan's Upper West Side—are each expected to have 30 to 40 units. 各店分配数量差异明显：第五大道预计获得超过 150 台样机，Apple Park 游客中心接近 100 台，普通门店平均约 20 台。芝加哥密歇根大道、洛杉矶 The Grove 和曼哈顿上西区三家门店，预计各有 30 至 40 台。

Apple has also designed a MagSafe stand that can simultaneously display one unfolded iPhone Duo and two regular iPhones, while some areas will offer phones without security tethers, allowing customers to experience StandBy. Stores will also be equipped with Presto devices adapted for the new phone, which can update the system without unpacking; US stores also plan to include the buyer's name as a greeting in English or Spanish upon the first boot-up. 苹果还设计了可同时展示一台展开的 iPhone Duo 与两台常规 iPhone 的 MagSafe 支架，部分区域则提供不系防盗线的手机，让顾客体验 StandBy。门店也将配备适配新机的 Presto 设备，可不拆包装更新系统；美国门店还计划在首次开机时以英语或西班牙语加入买家姓名作为问候。

Gurman stated that Apple had previously worried that production constraints would delay sales until late November, but now it has sufficient inventory to launch as planned, though supply will still be limited. Pre-orders for the iPhone Duo will begin on October 16. 古尔曼称，苹果此前曾担心产能限制会让销售推迟到 11 月下旬，如今已备足库存按原计划开售，但供货仍将有限。iPhone Duo 将于 10 月 16 日开启预订。

item.title: 沃尔玛新一代门店进入深圳，一个月连开三家
item.guid: 沃尔玛新一代门店进入深圳，一个月连开三家
item.description:
On October 11, Walmart's Shenzhen Futian KK ONE store opened. This is its 49th store in Shenzhen and the city's first new-generation store; within the previous month, the same store format had already opened new stores in Wenjiang, Chengdu, and Nanning. 10 月 11 日，沃尔玛深圳福田 KK ONE 店开业。这是其在深圳的第 49 家门店，也是该市首家新一代门店；此前一个月内，同一店型已在成都温江和南宁开出新店。

The new store adopts a single-story compact layout and a U-shaped circulation path, improving visual transparency by lowering shelf heights and widening main aisles. High-frequency categories like fresh produce are placed upfront, and table ingredients are centrally displayed. The product selection includes approximately 10,000 SKUs, with the private label 'Walmart Fresh' being a key focus, and multiple tasting stations are set up within the store. 新店采用单层紧凑布局和 U 型动线，通过降低货架高度、拓宽主通道提高视野通透度，并将生鲜等高频品类前置、餐桌食材集中陈列。商品选择约 1 万款 SKU，自有品牌「沃集鲜」成为重点，店内设置多个试吃点位。

This store format is also adjusting food displays and product assortments, increasing short-shelf-life fresh foods, baked goods, and seasonal items. Walmart Fresh's seasonal new arrivals revolve around osmanthus, covering beverages, baked goods, and compound seasonings, extending seasonal flavors to home kitchens. 这一店型也在调整食品陈列和商品组合，增加短保鲜食、烘焙及季节商品。沃集鲜当季上新围绕桂花展开，覆盖饮品、烘焙与复合调味料，把时令风味延伸到家庭厨房。

item.title: 科幻片《Overstake》用生成式 AI 重建场景，亮相釜山电影市场
item.guid: 科幻片《Overstake》用生成式-AI-重建场景，亮相釜山电影市场
item.description:
According to Variety, Hong Kong sales company Cappu Films has acquired the global sales agency rights for the sci-fi action thriller 'Overstake' and is promoting it to buyers at the Asian Contents & Film Market of the Busan International Film Festival. 据 Variety 报道，香港销售公司 Cappu Films 已取得科幻动作惊悚片《Overstake》的全球销售代理权，并在釜山国际电影节亚洲内容及电影市场向买家推介。

The film is written and directed by Stas Mareev. It is based on live-action footage, with scenes then reconstructed using generative AI. The story revolves around an injured veteran who must cross an industrial city within two hours to save his ex-wife's life; meanwhile, strangers' phones continuously receive betting tasks, allowing them to choose whether to help or hinder him. 影片由 Stas Mareev 编剧并执导，以真人拍摄为基础，再用生成式 AI 重建场景。故事围绕一名受伤老兵展开：他必须在两小时内穿过工业城市、保住前妻的性命；陌生人的手机则不断收到下注任务，可以选择帮助或阻拦他。

Mareev stated that he hopes to remake the film he has already directed, bringing to the screen a world scale that was not possible with past budgets. Actor performances and the story remain the foundation, with AI primarily helping to redesign environments, action scenes, and visual language. Mareev 表示，他希望重新制作这部自己已执导的电影，将过去预算无法实现的世界规模搬上银幕。演员表演和故事仍是基础，AI 主要帮助重新设计环境、动作场面与视觉语言。

The film's AI production is still underway, and Busan buyers saw a promotional video and a small number of completed clips this time. 影片的 AI 制作仍在进行中，釜山买家此次看到的是宣传片和少量已完成片段。

item.title: Laika 定格动画《Wildwood》首映，开发历时 16 年
item.guid: Laika-定格动画《Wildwood》首映，开发历时-16-年
item.description:
On October 11, Laika's stop-motion animated film "Wildwood" held its world premiere at the BFI London Film Festival. Director Travis Knight attended with voice actors Carey Mulligan, Peyton Elizabeth Lee, and Jacob Tremblay, and Knight recounted the 16-year development process of this fantasy feature film. 10 月 11 日，Laika 定格动画电影《Wildwood》在 BFI 伦敦电影节举行世界首映。导演 Travis Knight 与配音演员 Carey Mulligan、Peyton Elizabeth Lee 和 Jacob Tremblay 出席，Knight 在现场回顾了这部奇幻长片历时 16 年的开发过程。

The film is adapted from the original work by Colin Meloy and Carson Ellis. Laika acquired the adaptation rights and developed it for many years, entering production in 2021. Knight described the stop-motion animation work: the team creates thousands of miniature objects, lights them, photographs them, then moves the objects a tiny distance, and then continues photographing, repeating this process until the film is complete. 影片改编自 Colin Meloy 与 Carson Ellis 的原作，Laika 取得改编权后开发多年，于 2021 年进入制作。Knight 形容定格动画的工作：团队造出数以千计的微缩物件，布光、拍照，再把物件移动极小的距离，然后继续拍照，如此反复，直到电影完成。

He joked on stage that when the project started, Obama was still a new president in his first term; this amount of time was enough for him to complete medical school twice, and children born back then could now drive him to the premiere. 他在台上开玩笑说，项目启动时，奥巴马还是第一任期的新总统；这段时间足够让自己读完两次医学院，当年出生的孩子如今都能开车送他来参加首映。

According to Variety, "Wildwood" will be released in the US by Fathom Entertainment and in the UK by Black Bear on October 23, and it is also Laika's first feature film to receive a PG-13 rating. 据 Variety 报道，《Wildwood》将于 10 月 23 日由 Fathom Entertainment 在美国发行、Black Bear 在英国发行，也是 Laika 首部获得 PG-13 分级的长片。

item.title: 《银翼杀手 2099》发布新预告，杨紫琼与亨特·莎弗追查复制人失踪案
item.guid: 《银翼杀手-2099》发布新预告，杨紫琼与亨特·莎弗追查复制人失踪案
item.description:
Prime Video released a new trailer for "Blade Runner 2099" at New York Comic Con, and the official trailer page confirmed that this limited series, starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer, will premiere on November 25. Prime Video 在纽约漫展发布《银翼杀手 2099》新预告，官方预告页面确认，这部由杨紫琼、亨特·莎弗主演的限定剧将于 11 月 25 日上线。

The story is set 50 years after "Blade Runner 2049": a replicant uprising has occurred, and humans have lost their dominant position. Michelle Yeoh plays the replicant Blade Runner Olwen, who is tracking a missing colleague while her own lifespan is nearing its end; Schafer plays a human character who, to protect her brother, infiltrates the LAPD and impersonates a Blade Runner. 故事设定在《银翼杀手 2049》的 50 年后：复制人起义已经发生，人类失去主导地位。杨紫琼饰演的复制人银翼杀手 Olwen 正在追查一名失踪同僚，她自身的寿命也即将结束；莎弗饰演的人类角色则为保护弟弟，潜入洛杉矶警局并假扮银翼杀手。

The creators introduced on site that this suspenseful partnership runs throughout the series. The sets heavily utilize 360-degree spaces, incorporating lights, interactive screens, and mechanical devices into the scenes; the unusual color of Olwen's fingernails echoes the visual representation of replicant life decay in the first film. 主创在现场介绍，这一悬疑搭档关系贯穿剧集。布景大量采用 360 度空间，把灯光、可互动屏幕和机械装置放入场景；Olwen 指甲呈现的异常颜色，则呼应了第一部电影对复制人生命衰退的视觉表现。
